name: Checkout options
summary: Delivery and payment options as Selection cards with the price or a logo on the right (prop aside).
avoid: Options without an explanation or price: a normal Radio is enough.
anatomy: Selection cards (radio) with title, description and aside.
behaviour: Native radio group: arrow keys switch.
a11y: The aside is part of the label, so the price is read out.
content: A concrete time slot: "Tomorrow between 9:00 and 18:00".
dont: Pre-select a payment method that costs extra.
open: Payment logos (iDEAL, Visa) are not in the library yet.
